label: Frame-to-schema strictness controls for the route's NECESSARY_2 box
paraphrase: Formal controls on one explicit route frame (one world with no accessibility edge, one candidate individual present there): the B schema and the 5 schema of the frame's box are valid on it (vacuously: no world is accessible), while the route frame is neither KTB nor S5, because it is not reflexive. So neither schema premise entails its registered stronger frame premise. A statement about this interpretation only; no frame is claimed to be the frame of the route.
